subject.title: 飞书话题群(Topic Group)被识别为p2p导致消息路由错误

question: Which Feishu evidence should OpenClaw treat as authoritative when an `oc_...` conversation arrives with `chat_type: "p2p"`?
rationale: Current source still reproduces the misroute, but current tests also preserve p2p thread semantics, so automation should not choose an oc-prefix or thread/root fallback without maintainer intent.

options.title: Verify Narrow Topic Group Classifier
options.body: Treat only maintainer-verified Topic Group evidence as group and add regressions for both Topic Group and true p2p thread events.

options.title: Adopt Broader Topic Anchor PR
options.body: Let the larger Feishu topic-anchor work own the classifier and reply-anchor behavior if maintainers want one broader routing model.

options.title: Keep p2p Strict Until Live Proof
options.body: Leave p2p events direct until stronger live Feishu proof establishes a safe discriminator.

recommendation.title: Verify Narrow Topic Group Classifier
recommendation.body: Treat only maintainer-verified Topic Group evidence as group and add regressions for both Topic Group and true p2p thread events.

likelyOwner.reason: This user authored the central thread_id topic session routing change, making them the strongest history signal for the discriminator decision.
